context_requirements: Expression of AVPR1A, AVPR1B, AVPR2, or OXTR on the target cell
An active vasopressin/oxytocin-responsive signaling pathway (e.g., Gq/11 or Gs-coupled calcium or cAMP signaling)
A transcriptional program downstream of AVPR/OXTR activation; most immortalized lines lack this
falsifiers: Reproducible differential expression of >5 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes that are reversed by a vasopressin receptor agonist
Enrichment of AVPR/OXTR target gene signatures in the drug-treated profiles
